summary.text: Jeff Haylon is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Rutland-9 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a businessman and woodworker and a two-term Selectboard member running to represent Brandon and Forest Dale.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jeff Haylon as a graduate of Newtown High School who earned a bachelor's degree from Emory University in 2018 and has worked as a salesman.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has also served as a library trustee and on several other town boards and committees, has hosted a regular trivia night, and restored the historic blacksmith shop on his property.
Haylon named affordability, health care and education as his key campaign messages in the survey.
He wrote that he opposes closing local schools and is open to reducing the number of school districts in Vermont to cut redundant administration.
He listed education, healthcare and disaster resilience as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
